name: Pyromancer: Fueling the Fire erupts when Ember Touch hits a full-health Phoenix (#12779)
contract: #12779, #12781, #12177: Fueling the Fire 806747 reads 'Using Ember Touch on your Roaring Pyre or Phoenix
will cause them to erupt in flames, healing $806749i allies within $806749a1 yds', with no condition on the
pet's health. The eruption used to follow only an effective heal, so Ember Touch 800818 on a Phoenix at full
health healed 0 and nothing erupted, exactly as #12781 describes. The Phoenix is summoned at full health and
left there, so Ember Touch overheals it completely (asserted: its 800818 heal log shows no effective
healing); a grouped ally at 1 health beside it must still take a native heal log and effective healing from
806749. Ember Touch costs one Ember 807533 (ResourceCostRules, class 24). Asserted: before the cast the ally
has no 806749 heal, and within 3 s after Ember Touch on the full-health Phoenix it has at least one heal log

steps.label: Let spawn and level scaling settle
The ally joins the Pyromancer's group
The Phoenix settles beside its owner
Before the cast the ally has no Fueling the Fire heal
Ember Touch on the full-health Phoenix
Ember Touch lands on the Phoenix
The Phoenix was at full health, so Ember Touch healed it for nothing
#12779: the full-health Phoenix erupts and heals the ally
